version: 0.1.0
artifact_types:
- name: FR
traceability:
  trace_targets:
  - name: criterion
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    id_column: ID
  document_references:
  - name: verification
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    column: Verification
    row_id_column: ID
    pattern: '\b(TC-\d+)\b'
    targets: [criterion]
    strip_annotations: true
  status:
    column: Status
    complete: [Complete]
    pending: [Planned]
    failed: [Failed]
    retired: [⛔]
  obligations:
  - name: criteria
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    id_format: "{document}-AC-{row}"
    statement_column: Criteria
    method_column: Verification
  vocabularies:
    retired: [Inspection]
  trace_tags:
    markers:
    - name: rust-trace
      language: rust
      pattern: '#\[trace\(([^)]*)\)\]'
verification_catalog:
  unit:
    name: Unit test
    class: Test
    definition: An executable assertion.
    evidence_kind: Unit
